description: Threat verdict for a domain before an agent visits a link, signs a transaction or pays an invoice: Cloudflare risk types and content categories, popularity rank, recent URL-scanner verdicts and registration age. Returns clean, suspicious or malicious with flags. 0.003 USDC per call via x402.

paymentProof.description: Payment proof: USDC tx hash on Polygon or Base (0x...) or Solana tx signature. Omit on the first call to receive the 402 payment instructions, pay, then call again with the proof.

name: domain_reputation
